hooks.command: p=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.session_id'); dir="$HOME/.claude/skill-session-title"; mkdir -p "$dir"; seen="$dir/$sid.seen"; [ -f "$seen" ] && exit 0; touch "$seen"; prompt=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.prompt'); skill=$(printf '%s' "$prompt" | sed -n 's#^/\([A-Za-z0-9_:-]*\).*#\1#p'); [ -n "$skill" ] && printf '%s' "$skill" > "$dir/$sid.skill"; exit 0

p=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.session_id'); dir="$HOME/.claude/skill-session-title"; f="$dir/$sid.skill"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; skill=$(cat "$f"); tsid=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.tool_input.session_id'); title=$(echo "$p" | jq -r '.tool_input.title'); { [ "$tsid" = 'self' ] || [ "$tsid" = "$sid" ]; } || exit 0; [ -n "$title" ] || exit 0; case "$title" in '['*) exit 0 ;; esac; newtitle="[$skill] $title"; jq -n --arg t "$newtitle" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"allow",updatedInput:{title:$t}}}'
